title: Natural Language Processing for Dialects of a Language: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and comparing the performance degradation of NLP models (e.g., accuracy, BLEU scores) on Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and Generation (NLG) tasks when evaluated on non-standard dialects versus standard language, using dialect-specific datasets and rule-based dataset perturbations.

Evaluating disparities in hate speech and toxicity detection models, specifically measuring how text written in African-American English (AAE) is disproportionately misclassified as offensive or hate speech compared to Standard American English.

Analyzing language model predictions and generated outputs to detect stereotypes and prejudices regarding a speaker's employability, criminality, and social standing based purely on the linguistic markers of the dialects they use.
